name: Echo CS-4920
blurb: A 50.2 cc saw: 16″, 18″ and 20″ bars on .325″ chain, .050″ gauge, 66–78 drive links per Echo's own chart.
intro: The Echo CS-4920 is a 50.2 cc saw. Echo lists 16″, 18″ and 20″ bars for the CS-4920, all on .325″ pitch .050″ chain (66, 72 and 78 drive links). Every row below is restated from the bars-and-chains chart in Echo's chainsaw catalog, which gives the bar part number, chain part number, drive-link count, gauge, pitch and file size for each saw. Echo's catalog is written for dealers selling Echo loops, so the chain numbers are Echo part numbers; the pitch, gauge and drive-link count are what carry over to any other brand's chain. If your saw has had a replacement bar, check the stamp.
